label: Booking Payments
purpose: Payments received against bookings (number and amount in AED) by payment type, gateway, channel, market and customer, plus card payment-gateway transactions with success and error counts. Data from January 2022.
grain: One payment record on a booking line; about 5% of payments also carry card payment-gateway transactions.
use_for: payment mix by payment type and gateway
card / gateway transaction success and error rates
payments by customer, market, channel, supplier and product type
number of bookings that were paid
not_for: booking counts in general: only bookings with payments are here (Bookings)
outstanding balances or receivables (not in the cube)

coverage.note: Payments only from January 2022 (no earlier history); the current month is partial. By booking or travel date, recent months look low because many bookings are paid later.

dates.label: Payment date
dates.meaning: When the payment was made (the cube's main date). Plain period questions use it.

dates.label: Booking date
dates.meaning: When the paid booking was made.

dates.label: Travel date (check-in)
dates.meaning: Service start (check-in) date of the paid booking line.

measures.name: [% Payments Without Errors]
measures.label: Error-free payment rate
measures.definition: [Payments Without Errors] ÷ [Payments].

measures.name: [% Success Payments]
measures.label: Payment success rate
measures.definition: [Success Payments] ÷ [Booking Lines] (booking lines, not payments).
measures.notes: Within a payment-date period it is about 95%; without a date filter it drops to 54% because booking lines without any payment are counted too. Always filter a period (see review payments.success_rate).

measures.name: [% Success Transactions]
measures.label: Gateway success rate
measures.definition: [Success Transactions] ÷ [Transactions].

measures.name: [% Transactions Without Errors]
measures.label: Error-free transaction rate
measures.definition: [Transactions Without Errors] ÷ [Transactions].

measures.name: [AVG Diff Miliseconds]
measures.label: Average gateway transaction duration
measures.definition: [Diff Miliseconds] ÷ [Transactions]: average duration of a gateway transaction, in milliseconds.
measures.notes: Averages 1.8–3.3 hours, so it is likely the time from transaction start to its final status, not the gateway's response time (see review payments.duration_meaning).

measures.name: [Antifraud Error]
measures.label: Antifraud errors
measures.definition: Payments rejected by antifraud checks.
measures.hidden_reason: no data: 0 in all data (2022–2026); antifraud rejections are not recorded

measures.name: [Booking Error]
measures.label: Booking errors
measures.definition: Number of payment records where the booking reported an error.
measures.notes: Exact rule unknown; larger than the payments with errors, so it may count booking lines.

measures.name: [Booking Lines]
measures.label: Booking lines with payments
measures.definition: Number of booking lines in the payment records.
measures.notes: Without a date filter it also counts booking lines that have no payment (542K lines vs 299K payments).

measures.name: [Diff Miliseconds]
measures.label: Total gateway transaction duration
measures.definition: Sum of gateway transaction durations, in ms.
measures.hidden_reason: technical: numerator of [AVG Diff Miliseconds]; a sum of durations answers no business question

measures.name: [Max Diff Miliseconds]
measures.label: Longest gateway transaction duration
measures.definition: Longest gateway transaction duration in the selection, in milliseconds.
measures.notes: Up to about 92 days in the data; see review payments.duration_meaning.

measures.name: [Min Diff Miliseconds]
measures.label: Shortest gateway transaction duration
measures.definition: Shortest transaction duration, in ms.
measures.hidden_reason: always 0: payments without a gateway transaction count as 0 ms, so the minimum carries no information

measures.name: [Payments]

measures.name: [Payments Without Errors]

measures.name: [Revenue Payments]

measures.definition: Total amount of the payments received, in AED.
measures.notes: Money collected, not sales: for sales use the Bookings cube.

measures.name: [Revenue Transactions]
measures.label: Gateway transaction amount
measures.definition: Amount processed through card payment-gateway transactions, in AED. Covers only card payments made through a payment gateway (about 5% of payments); bank transfers, cash and journal entries have no gateway transaction.
measures.notes: Not known whether failed attempts are included; for money received use [Revenue Payments].

measures.name: [Success Transactions]
measures.label: Successful gateway transactions

measures.name: [Transaction Error]
measures.label: Gateway transaction errors
measures.definition: Gateway transactions that ended in an error. Covers only card payments made through a payment gateway (about 5% of payments); bank transfers, cash and journal entries have no gateway transaction.

measures.name: [Transactions]

rules: Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.
List every breakdown column together with its needs_columns (group-with helper columns).
Plain period questions filter 'Payment Date'[Payment Date] (when the money was paid); use the booking or travel date only when the question says so.
[Revenue Payments] is money collected, not sales; for sales, cost or profit use the Bookings cube.

Gateway measures ([Transactions], [Success Transactions], [Transaction Error], [Revenue Transactions], [AVG Diff Miliseconds], [Max Diff Miliseconds] and their rates) only cover card payments through a payment gateway, about 5% of payments.
Success and error rates are ratios and [Distinct Bookings] is a distinct count: never add or average them across rows; ask the cube at the level needed.
Always give [% Success Payments] a period filter; without one it is diluted by booking lines with no payment.
Never use the LYS measures; compare periods by querying each period.
Data starts in January 2022; all amounts are in AED.

review.question: "By market" in payments: the customer's market or the market recorded on the booking?
review.why: Matches the Bookings cube, which only has the customer's market; the two differ for a few markets (e.g. CIS).

review.question: "Payment success rate" = the cube's [% Success Payments], which divides successful payments by booking lines (not by payments). Keep it?
review.why: It is the cube's own success rate and gives about 95% for any payment-date period; only its all-time figure (54%) is distorted, and the app always filters a period.

review.question: What does "Diff Miliseconds" measure on gateway transactions?
options: time from transaction start to final status
review.proposed: time from transaction start to final status
review.why: The average is 1.8–3.3 hours and the maximum about 92 days, far too long for a gateway response time; the app labels it "transaction duration" until confirmed.
